cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY); Oliver B. James, New York, NY, 1943; Lettie Corlett, Oakland, California, bequest, 1954; B. C. Holland Gallery, Chicago, Illinois, 1960s; Maxwell Galleries, Ltd., San Francisco, California, 1969; ACA Galleries, New York, NY, 1969; Harry Spiro, New York, NY, 1969; Kennedy Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, 1970; Private collection, Aspen, Colorado, 1972 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Letter from Oliver B. James. . . . "We own 'Oak Leaves Pink and Grey' . . . unsigned, in good condition . . . purchased by me from An American Place.' Note: The 1930 Georgia O'Keeffe exhibition lists the 'Oak Leaves' owned by the Univ. of Minnesota and this may be a smaller version not listed in the catalogue. Miss Georgia O'Keeffe does not remember this picture." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Oak Leaves, Pink and Grey

description: Yellow, white, and tan oak leaves hang from the upper lefthand corner of the composition. Below, blue forms extend outward from a dark center like petals of a large flower.
title: Oak Leaves, Pink and Grey
